utterances.speaker: MIRKO ZELENIKA [Resumed]
utterances.text: You can't say that it existed.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I misunderstood. So you're saying -- let me go back and repeat my prior question then. You're telling the Judges that the MUP of Herceg-Bosna did not exist and did not operate in Jablanica municipality in November 1992.

utterances.speaker: MIRKO ZELENIKA [Resumed]
utterances.text: I never saw a single car. I never saw a single uniformed police officer belonging to the Herceg-Bosna MUP anywhere in Jablanica municipality at that time. Had the MUP actually existed in the area, I believe I would have seen some of them around.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Scott, we're going to break now because we have a question for Mr. Karnavas, and we have two minutes left. Witness, you shall return tomorrow at 9.00. I wish you a very good afternoon. Mr. Karnavas, very quickly.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On behalf of the Trial Chamber I want to ask you this with regard to the translation problems you had with the expert report, are you asking for a decision by the Trial Chamber? What we need to know is what the registry told you to account for the fact that the translation was not carried out?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I believe they told us they won't do it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, but did they give a reason for that, or means, or cost of it? What kind of motives or reasons did they give? If you can't answer now, do that later, but we need to know what the reason was that was given by the registry.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: The reason was, Your Honours, that it was written in one of the official languages, which was English, the languages being English and French. Here it is. I found it. "Is rejecting our request because the original language document is in English. Exhibits must be filed in their original language and one of the Tribunal's working languages. In this case the original language is one of the working languages." So that's rather circular. Now, the accused, of course, cannot read English, at least not all of them, and so -- and there has been an application, and a right one, that the document be translated so that the accused who are entitled to assist in their own defence and give instructions to -- to their attorneys, to their counsel, have it in a language in which they understand. So that's why. Now, we have another -- we have another -- with our other expert which is being done in B/C/S, due to the time factor, and the reports are very smaller. We're doing that on our own as opposed to relying on ODM. So we're trying to pick up the slack as much as we can. And those two -- two reports will be filed within the next few days.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. I understood the problem now. Well, the Trial Chamber will deliberate. Mr. Scott, you have used one hour and 21 minutes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. And if I can have 30 seconds additional seconds of the Chamber's time. On behalf of Mr. Stringer. Your Honour, the Defence have filed two motions, and forgive me, I'm looking at the e-mail obviously. The Defence has filed two motions. One on the 12th of October and one on the 14th of October concerning matters regarding the witness Raguz, and the other one concerning the witness Zoran Perkovic. The Prosecution requests to make a combined response 14 days from the 14th of October.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It might be better to have one answer for the two motions that deal with the same issue. No problem.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I wish everybody a good afternoon. We shall reconvene tomorrow morning at 9.00. I'm starting another hearing in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 16th day of October, 2008, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.46 p.m.,
